meta.name: create-website
meta.description: Guided journey from a blank page to a live, high-converting website, built message-first, then design, then conversion. Orchestrates ten skills phase by phase - one-page-marketing, storybrand-messaging, made-to-stick, top-design, web-typography, refactoring-ui, ux-heuristics, cro-methodology, scorecard-marketing, steve-jobs-design-review - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (POSITIONING.md, WEBSITE.md, DESIGN.md, CREATE-WEBSITE-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to build a new website or landing page from scratch, turn a validated idea into a page that converts, or says 'build me a landing page for my SaaS'. Site already exists: use improve-website to fix conversion/UX or grow-website for more traffic; building a software product, not a marketing site: use create-app; no positioning yet: run create-business first or the positioning phase here. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.

copy.tagline: 从零构建高转化营销网站，分阶段引导完成信息、设计与转化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要从头搭建一个营销网站或落地页，并希望系统化完成信息、设计与转化优化

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你一步步从零开始创建网站：先确定信息，再设计外观，最后优化转化。每一步都会问你问题，并把结果保存到项目文件夹，下次可以继续。
howto.when: 当你想新建一个网站或落地页，或者说“给我的 SaaS 做个落地页”时触发。如果网站已存在，请用 improve-website 或 grow-website。

say.text: 帮我从零开始建一个网站，卖我的在线课程。
say.note: Claude 会开始引导你完成十个阶段。

say.text: 我想为我的 SaaS 产品做一个落地页。
say.note: Claude 会先询问产品、受众等信息。

say.text: 继续上次的网站创建流程。
say.note: Claude 会读取项目文件，从中断处继续。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you step by step from a blank page to a live, high-converting website: message first, then design, then conversion. It asks questions at every decision point and records results in the project's docs/ folder, so the journey can resume across sessions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to build a new website or landing page from scratch, or say 'build me a landing page for my SaaS'. If a site already exists, use improve-website or grow-website instead.

say_en.text: Help me build a website from scratch for my online course.
say_en.note: Claude will start guiding you through the ten phases.

say_en.text: I want to create a landing page for my SaaS product.
say_en.note: Claude will first ask about the product, audience, etc.

say_en.text: Resume the website creation process from where I left off.
say_en.note: Claude will read the project files and continue from the last checkpoint.
